glossary.definition: Actual less budget is measured in the account’s own units. An increased cost can have a positive account variance and an adverse negative effect on profit. The bridge uses saved steps in the displayed root’s units.
Exact agreement within the supplied source panels and saved calculations. It is not ledger authentication or financial approval.
Materiality is a size rule. Significance and persistence are separate saved diagnostics; unavailable results do not become insignificant or one-off.
A conditional projection from saved YTD inputs, assumptions and remaining periods. A point-only result has no publishable uncertainty interval or probability. Model estimates are uncalibrated.
This bundle retains dated prior variance observations and an optional supersedes identifier. It does not establish a complete inventory of later or related closes.

review_items.action: Review material accounts and unavailable diagnostics, then confirm causes with the business.
review_items.explanation: Material amounts can require review even when significance or persistence cannot be computed. A saved classification does not establish a business explanation or calibrated forecast.
